title.narrative: Operating a mobile health care system for those affected by the earthquake in Syria

description.narrative: Providing primary health care services and community and nutritional awareness to those affected in a number of Syrian regions. It is expected that more than 385,111 beneficiaries will benefit from the project on a regular and free basis.

Providing the necessary health services in light of the large number of injured people who cannot be transported to hospitals, and health and nutritional care services for the displaced / each child receiving his full milk needs monthly.

Urgent medical support is divided into two parts: operating a system of mobile clinics consisting of mobile field medical teams / securing and distributing infant formula to groups affected by the earthquake.
